bio: ‘Don Ciccio’ is the nickname of a Sicilian Cosa Nostra boss in The Godfather. Used by those close to the Don, ‘Ciccio’ means ‘broad-shouldered gentleman’. The restaurant's name reflects the chef's aspiration of becoming a beloved ‘Don’ or culinary figure. He is a pioneer, dedicated to spreading the joy of Sicilian cuisine. This ‘Don Corleone of Sicilian cuisine’ conveys the flavours of the Mediterranean with lemons and herbs....
